```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-mom-cap
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Metal-oxide-metal (MOM) capacitors: (a) vertical sandwich capacitor (cross section) using the plate capacitance between stacked metal layers, with alternating layers connected to the two terminals by via stacks; (b) finger capacitor (top view) using the lateral coupling capacitance between interdigitated fingers drawn in a single metal layer."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Polygon

M_COL = ['#7fb3d5', '#f0b27a', '#82c785', '#c39bd3']   # Metal1 .. Metal4
VIA_COL = '#566573'                                    # vias

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.6))

# (a) sandwich capacitor cross section: each metal layer in its own color,
# vias in a separate color to show that all of these are distinct layers
ax = axs[0]
n_layers = 4
for i in range(n_layers):
    y = i * 1.0
    if i % 2 == 0:   # plates of terminal A, flush left
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, y), 5.0, 0.45, fc=M_COL[i], ec='k',
                               lw=0.8))
    else:            # plates of terminal B, flush right
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.0, y), 5.0, 0.45, fc=M_COL[i], ec='k',
                               lw=0.8))
    ax.text(0.3, y + 0.22, f'M{i + 1}', fontsize=8, color='0.35',
            ha='center', va='center')

# terminal via stacks: A at far left (where the B plates do not reach),
# B at far right (where the A plates do not reach). Each stack connects the
# plates i and i+2 and hence needs a landing pad on the layer in between.
for (x, i0) in ((1.3, 0), (6.4, 1)):
    y0 = i0 * 1.0 + 0.45
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y0), 0.3, 0.55, fc=VIA_COL, ec='k', lw=0.6))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y0 + 0.55), 0.3, 0.45, fc=M_COL[i0 + 1],
                           ec='k', lw=0.6))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y0 + 1.0), 0.3, 0.55, fc=VIA_COL, ec='k',
                           lw=0.6))

# terminal leads
ax.plot([1.45, 1.45], [2.45, 4.0], color='k', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([6.55, 6.55], [3.45, 4.0], color='k', lw=1.0)
ax.text(1.45, 4.15, 'A', fontsize=11, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax.text(6.55, 4.15, 'B', fontsize=11, ha='center', va='bottom')

handles = [Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, fc=c, ec='k', lw=0.6) for c in M_COL]
handles.append(Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, fc=VIA_COL, ec='k', lw=0.6))
ax.legend(handles, ['M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'via'], loc='upper center',
          bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.06), ncol=5, frameon=False, fontsize=8,
          handlelength=1.0, handleheight=1.0, columnspacing=1.0,
          handletextpad=0.4)

ax.set_title('(a) sandwich capacitor', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 8.2); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, 5.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

# (b) finger capacitor top view: one single metal layer, so both combs are
# drawn as merged polygons in the very same color
ax = axs[1]
COMB_COL = M_COL[0]
comb_a = [(0.5, 0.0), (0.5, 4.6), (1.1, 4.6),
          (1.1, 4.35), (6.5, 4.35), (6.5, 3.85), (1.1, 3.85),
          (1.1, 2.55), (6.5, 2.55), (6.5, 2.05), (1.1, 2.05),
          (1.1, 0.75), (6.5, 0.75), (6.5, 0.25), (1.1, 0.25), (1.1, 0.0)]
comb_b = [(7.7, 0.0), (7.7, 4.6), (7.1, 4.6),
          (7.1, 3.45), (1.7, 3.45), (1.7, 2.95), (7.1, 2.95),
          (7.1, 1.65), (1.7, 1.65), (1.7, 1.15), (7.1, 1.15), (7.1, 0.0)]
for comb in (comb_a, comb_b):
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(comb, closed=True, fc=COMB_COL, ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(0.8, 4.75, 'A', fontsize=11, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax.text(7.4, 4.75, 'B', fontsize=11, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax.text(4.1, -0.5, 'single metal layer (M1)', fontsize=8, color='0.35',
        ha='center', va='center')
ax.set_title('(b) finger capacitor', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 8.2); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, 5.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
